informal_statement: A regular negative-fold type-(iii) root at a modeled type-(iv) area lies below that type-(iv) curvature.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At SameCurvatureArea.lean:586-622, the source contract is `theorem typeThreeArea_descending_root_lt {lam root h : ℝ} (hlam : 1 < lam) (hroot : root ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hfold : typeThreeFold lam root < 0) (harea : typeThreeArea lam root = typeFourArea lam h) : root < h`. The strict same-curvature area inequality is proved for lambda > 1 and 0 < h <= 1. Combining it with monotonicity of the negative-fold branch gives a descending equal-area root strictly below the four-arc curvature, not above it.
